versions.title: Reliable Subscriptions and Cleaner Activity
versions.summary: Duskry now keeps paid subscriptions refreshed and makes busy days easier to understand.

items.text: Paid licenses now refresh automatically instead of expiring locally after seven days.
Short application switches are grouped into a compact timeline summary.
The Activity page now opens in a minimal Summary view with Details available when needed.

versions.title: Activity Management Improvements
versions.summary: Duskry now makes it much easier to organize, bulk-manage, and review your tracked activities.

items.text: You can now select multiple activities at once and assign them together from the Activity page.
Projects can now be cleared from individual activities or whole selections directly from Activity and Overview.
Dragging a selected activity to a project now assigns the full current selection.
Bulk actions now include quick delete, select all, and cleaner selection controls.

versions.title: Background Scenes and What's New Modal
versions.summary: Duskry now has a richer scenic background system with more customization.

items.text: Added more scenic day, dusk, and night backgrounds.
You can now change both the start time and assigned background for each auto scene slot.
Background selection is smoother with direct hover actions in Appearance.
Added a 'What's New' modal to highlight new features after updates.
